entities.name: Hidari Jingorō
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hidari Jingorō  was a possibly fictitious Japanese artist. Some people and sources state his real name was Itami Toshikatsu. A Renaissance man, he worked as a sculptor, carpenter, painter, architect, comedian, actor, kōdanshi and professor of art. Although various studies suggest he was active in the early Edo period, there are controversies about the historical existence of the person. Jingorō is believed to have created many famous deity sculptures located throughout Japan, and many legends have been told about him.
